messages:
sasha: quick sync — we need to lock rollout windows for v2.15 across US / EU / APAC. tentative target is next Fri (2026-04-02). who has objections to the cutoff schedule below?

miguel: sounds good. what are the exact cutoff times? timezone-sensitive apps need heads-up.

sasha: proposing:
```
US cutoff: 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC (allow 2h warmup)
EU cutoff: 2026-04-02 08:00 UTC (canary 20m)
APAC cutoff: 2026-04-02 18:00 UTC (night ops window)
Feature freeze (branch cut): 2026-04-01 23:00 UTC
Changelog finalization: 2026-04-01 12:00 UTC (PRs merged by then)
```

priya: can we shift EU by +1h? our infra team wants canary at 09:00 CET to align with support. otherwise fine.

tom: +1h EU is fine for me. also tagging @deploy-bot to pin the deploy pipeline windows.

deploy-bot: noted — will schedule pipelines: release/v2.15 -> rollout orchestration. Will emit channel alerts at T-24h, T-1h.

jenna: small ask: please add a changelog bullet for the KV cache fix (PR #4217). I'll queue the PR now, but it needs a final review before 2026-04-01 12:00 UTC.

miguel: pinging infra-qa: can we get a quick smoke pass on dedicated infra for the EU canary? usual checklist: healthchecks, latency SLOs, token accounting.

sasha: good call. miguel, please confirm by EOD today if infra-qa can do it. if not, we push EU window +1h and notify support.

priya: infra-qa confirmed in the thread — they can run smoke tests but need the build by 2026-04-02 06:30 UTC. that fits +1h schedule.

sasha: ok locking windows: US 02:00 UTC, EU 09:00 CET (08:00 UTC), APAC 18:00 UTC. feature branch cut 2026-04-01 23:00 UTC. changelog final by 2026-04-01 12:00 UTC.

tom: will create the release checklist on the wiki and add links to the pipelines. I'll also add the rollback playbook reminder.

jenna: just merged doc update: please review changelog PR #4289 when you have a minute. small wording change only.

miguel: quick note — for APAC window, ops wants a 30m post-rollout monitoring hold; can we block APAC traffic to new variant for that time if any alerts?

sasha: yes — plan is: post-rollout hold = 30m, automatic rollback on P99 latency spike > 500ms OR error rate > 1.5%. I will add these thresholds to the rollout policy.

deploy-bot: rollout policy updated. Canary -> Full if canary healthy for 20m. Automatic rollback triggers set (latency/error). Alerts to #oncall and #support.

priya: nice. last ask — who will be the release responder for the EU window?

jenna: I can be EU responder for that slot. tom will cover US, miguel on APAC.

sasha: thanks all. action items:
- tom: publish wiki checklist + pipeline links (today)
- jenna: final changelog review (by 2026-04-01 12:00 UTC)
- miguel: infra smoke pass + APAC responder confirmation (EOD)
- priya: update rollout policy with the thresholds (done)
- deploy-bot: channel alerts at T-24h/T-1h

sasha: tagging for visibility @eng-sre @support @product. we'll treat this thread as the canonical rollout coordination. any blockers, drop them here. :thumbsup:
